responsibility: Declares public helper routines shared by GCC’s value-range propagation and range-folding code rather than a pass by itself. It exposes comparison and constant-range predicates, unary and binary range folding interfaces, bitmask/nonzero-bit intersection helpers, switch-case lookup helpers for mapping ranges or values onto gswitch labels, overflow-comparison recognition, and edge-based nonzero-bit propagation utilities used by VRP, ranger clients, and related simplification code.
same_name_distinction: Header companion to tree-vrp.cc that exposes shared VRP and range-query/folding helper declarations, such as case-label lookup and nonzero-bit utilities. Unlike tree-vrp.cc, it does not define the VRP passes or execute ranger-based propagation.
